security.title: Use of Hard-coded Password
security.description: The product contains a hard-coded password, which it uses for its own inbound authentication or for outbound communication to external components.

evidence.explanation: Sensitive password values are embedded in deployment configuration: the SQL service manifest defines the SQL administrator password, and the ARM test parameter file contains a cluster administrator password. Values are intentionally masked in this assessment. The example client-secret field in DeploymentHelper.cs is a placeholder and is not counted as a live credential.
